citations.label: blog.szypowi.cz, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when telemetry is on (summary)
citations.excerpt: the loader sits behind a remote feature flag. With telemetry or nonessential traffic turned off, a local AGENTS.md is skipped without a warning.

citations.label: blog.szypowi.cz, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when telemetry is on (gate)
citations.excerpt: When Claude Code cannot fetch the flag, the plugin is unavailable, and the local file is never read.

citations.label: blog.szypowi.cz, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when telemetry is on (silence)
citations.excerpt: None of these cases print a warning. The session starts, the model answers without the project instructions, and nothing tells you that a file was skipped.

citations.label: anthropics/claude-code issue 95690, independent reproduction in the thread
citations.excerpt: AGENTS.md is skipped in the very first session after install, and skipped every time when feature-flag fetching is disabled (`DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK=1` or nonessential traffic off), which is exactly what CI runners do. It loads fine once the flag is cached locally, so this is a rollout-gating gap rather than a parser bug.

citations.label: blog.szypowi.cz, Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when telemetry is on (diagnosis)
citations.excerpt: I confirmed the cause with a canary word and a string search through the binary, and most people will not do that.

citations.label: Anthropic, Claude Code CHANGELOG (AGENTS.md fix entry)
citations.excerpt: Changed AGENTS.md support to also work on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry, LLM gateways, and sessions with telemetry disabled

citations.label: Anthropic, Claude Code release notes (telemetry settings notice)
citations.excerpt: Added a startup notice, and /status and claude doctor entries, listing telemetry variables in a project's settings files that were ignored or that turned telemetry off

citations.label: Anthropic, Claude Code release notes (telemetry-off default mode)
citations.excerpt: Changed interactive sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured; permissions.defaultMode still overrides it

citations.label: anthropics/claude-code issue 95690, opening report
